name: Base64 Encode / Decode
summary: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, entirely in your browser.
description: Convert any UTF-8 text to Base64 and back. Handles emoji and accented characters correctly. Everything runs locally — your data never leaves the browser.

faqs.question: Does my text get uploaded anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. Encoding and decoding run entirely in your browser using the built-in APIs.

faqs.question: Does it support Unicode and emoji?
faqs.answer: Yes. Text is encoded as UTF-8 first, so emoji and accented characters round-trip correctly.

faqs.question: What is the difference from URL-safe Base64?
faqs.answer: Standard Base64 uses + and / with = padding. URL-safe Base64 replaces those characters — used by JWTs, for example.
